ZY01_fixed18_correctness.baseline_ZY01_ZY03_note: alpha/SNV/SVC of this one pair is exact sealed old prediction reuse, not a fresh independent fit; four otherZY01-held alpha/SNV/SVC cells are newly executed.

verified_findings_zh: 全25个来源组留出任务及diagnose共26项、130个封存文件和闭合账本行hash均通过只读核验。每固定配置2580条评价仅对应516个唯一TRAIN样品，不增加实物或批次数。
原α/SNV/SVC的旧23错在5个ZY01-held组合均持续，正确数187/186/186/187/186除210；但是α/SNV/LR每组208/210，旧23中21条均恢复，只有ZY01-007、013在该配置五组始终错。跨18配置×5组没有样品始终错，不能用某一个模型的稳定误判认定整本或子集物种。
表示与模型依赖很强：n/raw/LR在ZY01为208–210/210，但n/SNV/SVC仅84–89/210、n/SNV/PLS为0/210。全25配置结果必须成套保留，不事后挑最高分作为预先指定赢家。
all240下SVC balanced与unweighted在三模态五组逐条预测相同；减酸donor到6/24/60能改善部分ZY01预测，但改变source覆盖、scaler与RBF几何，不是纯类别权重或纯数量的独立因果证明。α donor6三seed合ZY01=3080/3150、酸872/900，存在28次酸误判代价；donor24为3029/3150与900/900。
旧23的α谱范数中位1384.83高于其余187的1191.53；n频谱标准差中位0.2204高于0.06435。ZY01原值全部有限、非flat且α/n无负值；007、009等在若干幅值/起伏指标较极端。它们是事后质控线索，不是自动删点或改标签依据。
hypotheses_zh: 现有数据与source覆盖不足、表征/预处理及固定模型边界影响一致，尚未唯一定位原因。
SNV移除了单谱水平/幅度信息；n的raw与SNV巨大差异提示该信息对当前分类有作用，但不能把这种作用直接解释为物种化学差异。
部分旧错误在原值幅值/起伏上偏极端，可作为后续独立测量/数据处理核查候选；仍缺仪器、日期、批次和真实厚度资料。
limits: All labels remain the original user-confirmed Chinese kinds; no biological identity reclassification is established.
Results are retrospective masterTRAIN-only sourcegroup diagnostics. One sourcegroup is not a verified new batch; shared ancestry/instrument/preparation remain unknown.

Raw/SNV, model choices, donor counts, seeds and error-subset analyses are prespecified or posthoc exploratory comparisons. No query-based parameter change, best-config selection, p-value or independent cohort claim follows.
QC comparison is posthoc for old23 versus187. ReferencePCA/distances fit306nonZY01 binaryTRAIN and do not provide independent species probabilities. Ordinal position is not verified acquisition time.
Repeated sourcepair/sampling-seed rows and related alpha/n measurements do not enlarge independentN. Class-specific tradeoffs and new mistakes must remain visible.
Later calibration and neural mechanisms are not concluded here, even if their live queue has progressed by report time. No ongoing healthy process or upload path was interrupted.
